inventory.timing_scope: One CPU Gate on the Phase 0 commit; duration includes pytest setup, call, and teardown for each collected case.

retired_tests.reason: The sync-only CUDA stream barrier changed Projection timing and is superseded by the barrier-free sampled-token lifecycle.
The file gate paused decode-commit delivery and is superseded by normal asynchronous acknowledged delivery.
The proxy isolation gate delayed Projection and commit after Prefill and is superseded by the ungated request lifecycle.
The synchronous sampled-token D2H arm and its selector were removed; AsyncOutput callback delivery now protects the lifecycle.
OFFLOAD_EXEC descriptors no longer carry sampled tokens; decode commit remains protected through the acknowledged commit lifecycle.
Attention no longer commits token-bearing descriptors and always joins KV readiness with the asynchronous sampled-token sideband.
The token-bearing OFFLOAD_EXEC protocol version was retired; compact token-free descriptor round trips remain protected.
Qwen3 no longer builds descriptor token rows; TP request identity is preserved by token-free OFFLOAD_EXEC step groups.
Missing descriptor token rows are no longer a runtime case because sampled tokens use only the reliable asynchronous sideband.

invariants.statement: Decode-commit messages round-trip without ambiguity and reject missing, malformed, or non-monotonic state.
Offload descriptors preserve request, layer, routing, tensor, and topology identity across supported wire forms.
Proxy payloads keep Prefill as KV owner and never make a PAP Projection allocate or claim prompt KV.
Any positive xPAyP topology has stable, balanced, auditable PA and Projection pair routing without equal-count assumptions.
Tensor-parallel endpoints and mailbox actor identities remain rank-specific while retaining a stable logical source identity.
Projection membership updates are generation ordered, stale updates are ignored, and active sources determine combine scope.
Sampled-token delivery is asynchronous, joins exactly once with KV readiness, fails closed on mismatch, and flushes before drain.
Decode commits advance the token ledger monotonically with ACK, deduplication, bounded retry, coalescing, and fail-closed errors.
KV leases outlive all pending commits, release idempotently, expire safely, and leave zero active Attention sessions at drain.
Attention sessions enforce creation, activation, generation, capacity, stale-epoch rejection, and idempotent cleanup ordering.
Prefill owns the only physical paged KV, Projection stays KV-unaware, and Attention appends decode KV into owned capacity.
A request-scoped sealed manifest installs a complete static layer catalog atomically and rejects incomplete or stale generations.
Decode append maps every active row to valid owned slots, detects ABA and topology conflicts, and performs GPU work outside locks.
Multi-turn history preserves exact token identity and accounts only materialized complete blocks as decode-derived cache hits.
Paged and segmented GQA attention preserve layout, dtype, causal semantics, and numerical equivalence to the reference result.
Metadata and slot-plan caches use generation-safe fast keys, preserve row order and LRU atomicity, and fall back only for input.
Single-Projection topology executes each ready Attention item directly while preserving CUDA readiness and input lifetime.
Multi-Projection topology combines only compatible same-layer work and scatters each result to its stable originating source.
Same-host local-fast transport preserves stream ordering, slot ownership, ready signaling, output lifetime, and bounded capacity.
Cross-host NIXL mailbox preserves registered-buffer lifetime, slot ownership, ACK release, metadata, and transfer-handle reuse.
PAP is enabled only by explicit request metadata, routes only PAP requests, and leaves ordinary vLLM request behavior unchanged.
Qwen3 PAP adapters route QKV, Attention outputs, sampled tokens, Prefill handles, and finished-request cleanup exactly once.
Proxy registration, readiness, Prefill, Projection, commit, and release endpoints preserve one fail-closed request lifecycle.
The scheduler tracks PAP Projection remote progress without local KV block allocation or local cache registration.
Stats, traces, and audits expose complete PAP evidence without changing request ordering, synchronization, or execution semantics.
Launch composition derives valid process counts, ports, TP ranks, placement, and transport wiring from one topology profile.
The benchmark launcher records effective configuration, provenance, correctness, routing, join, lease, and zero-session drain evidence.
The P17 launcher selects and audits only the accepted static MPS partition with 64 Prefill and 28 Attention visible SMs.
P17 uses the frozen model, token-exact 16K five-turn workload, C4 arrival semantics, and 256 output tokens per turn.
Benchmark validation fails closed on token, cache, request-shape, routing, join, correctness, artifact, or session-drain mismatch.
Formal aggregation uses three distinct repetitions, pooled request-level R1 and steady metrics, and compatible fingerprints.
Formal evidence records one full commit, a clean tracked worktree, empty tracked patches, artifact hashes, and hardware identity.
